patch_description: Improves on the vectorized greedy LPT packing by adding a fully-vectorized local-swap refinement pass: for each row, repeatedly identify the heaviest-loaded pack and lightest-loaded pack, then swap the largest item in the overloaded pack with the smallest item in the underloaded pack whenever it reduces the load spread (a > b). This goes beyond LPT's 4/3-approximation while keeping O(k·num_packs) batched ops (constant number of kernel launches per iteration), so algorithm time stays ~0. Also uses the batched top-k marginal-gain replication (provably identical to sequential greedy) to cut the replication loop, and avoids the CPU round-trip of the weight tensor, matching the fastest prior variant. Both the group-to-node packing and the physical-expert-to-GPU packing benefit from the refinement, improving GPU balancedness without hurting speed.
